integrity: The theorem is accompanied by a standalone standard-library verifier. Finite quotient exhaustiveness is justified by a size-independent support factor; no claim of independent certification is made.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the deterministic three-state, threshold-one, synchronous rule on complete multipartite graphs with at least three nonempty parts. The universal cutoff uses an explicit exhaustive 2158-class finite quotient certificate; nonmultipartite cases, four-state rules and attraction-basin distribution are not established. Potential unindexed historical equivalences remain a priority risk.
title: Four-step periodic entry and exact three-cycle census for multipartite excitable dynamics
